issue.title: Lab 7 proposal: increase expense amount limit to 150,000 baht (approval pending)
issue.author: chaproi
issue.body:
## Proposal only — NOT EFFECTIVE / approval pending

Student-proposed Lab 7 change to existing Sprint 1 BR-01: increase the whole-baht expense-request ceiling from 100,000 to 150,000. This is an intentional requirement change, not a bug fix or completion of unchanged Sprint 2/3 backlog. No implementation or RED test has been written/executed for this proposal.

### Baseline and actual pre-change identity
- Accepted Sprint 1: 43aa8d7472aa8852654d0d634d7239c3765c5869. Its baseline BR-01/T-05, server validator and PostgreSQL CHECK all enforce 1–100,000.
- Actual pre-change/current fetched main: cc6b04c8e98191be591a3b755d25988148523909; last verified deployed release remains this SHA, not newly queried live today.
- Completed D2 documentation: 427d7c01ea9a62a5172a9a85ce4c6a9d48326e23, preserved separately.
- Proposal branch: docs/lab7-amount-limit-proposal, based on origin/main cc6b04c.

### Exact proposed semantics
- F-02 creation and owning Requester F-05 RETURNED edits accept numeric integer amounts 1–150,000 inclusive, including 1, 100000, 100001 and 150000.
- Reject 150001, zero, negative, fractional, missing and non-number amounts without domain writes.
- Preserve role/session, ownership, Origin, body shape, server assignment, status, revision/concurrency and atomic history protections. Submitted and terminal requests remain read-only.
- Preserve title/category/lower-bound rules, explicit Save/Resubmit and draft recovery/BF-01. No new currency, precision, budget, totals, filter or approval-stage feature.
- Do not rewrite existing records, timestamps, revisions or history.

Student-proposed rationale: allow a larger single club activity/equipment request while retaining whole-baht values and the current approval process. No stakeholder request or policy approval is claimed.

### Actual impact found
`parseExpenseInput` validates creation and is reused by `parseReturnedInput` for returned edits. Both client amount inputs have max100000. The applied original migration also creates `ExpenseRequest_amountBaht_check` with BETWEEN 1 AND 100000. A new additive migration widening this CHECK is necessary; changing only the UI/parser would be incomplete. PostgreSQL INTEGER/Prisma Int, API shape, authorization and transaction protocols need no change. Never edit an applied migration or narrow the constraint over larger saved values during rollback.

### Proposed contract / verification
AC-L7-01–08 and STS-L7-01–10 are PLANNED / UNEXECUTED. They cover both operation boundaries, independent API and database enforcement, native UI constraints, no-write invalid/denied/stale cases, exact ID/revision/event behavior, draft recovery, populated migration preservation, restart/readback and original Sprint 1 approve/reject.

Only the existing 100001-invalid expectations would legitimately change after approval; unrelated tests/assertions remain. Future work follows contract review → tests-only semantic RED on the actual old source → bounded GREEN and additive migration → regression → substantive peer PR review/CI → staging → reviewed main → migration-before-deploy → changed/preserved live checks. Historical runs do not count as new maintenance evidence.

Published documentation-only commit: [12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/commit/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb). Approval and peer review remain PENDING; no tests or production changes.
- [Proposal and impact](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/blob/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb/docs/labs/lab-07/proposal.md)
- [Proposed contract and planned STS](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/blob/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb/docs/labs/lab-07/contract-proposed-v1.md)
- [A-D evidence and metrics plan](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/blob/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb/docs/labs/lab-07/evidence-plan.md)

pullRequest.title: Lab 7: Review proposed expense amount-limit contract
pullRequest.author: chaproi
pullRequest.body:
Refs #49

## Purpose and approval state

Independent peer **contract review only** of a student-proposed Lab 7 maintenance change: increase BR-01's maximum whole-baht expense amount from **100,000 to 150,000** for F-02 creation and existing owner-authorized F-05 RETURNED edits.

**Instructor/TA approval: PENDING. Proposed contract: NOT EFFECTIVE. Independent peer contract review: PENDING.** This PR requests substantive review of the proposed requirements and impact analysis. Peer contract review does **not** substitute for instructor/TA approval, and existing solo-project permission does not approve this particular maintenance change. Record the actual instructor/TA decision and the exact peer-reviewed contract revision before RED/implementation.

**Implementation and all Lab 7 RED/GREEN executions remain UNEXECUTED.** No application code, tests, migration, schema, dependency, environment or workflow changes are included. No application suite was run to prepare this PR. Earlier Sprint 1/D2 results retain their original tested versions; they are not new maintenance results. Any automatically triggered CI checks the unchanged application under this documentation combination, not implementation of the proposed limit.

## Exact comparison and provenance

- Head: `docs/lab7-amount-limit-proposal` at **12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb**.
- Base: `staging/sprint-2` at **ecab746d02b33a140775f53a5079bb7f57f5cd42** when opened.
- Accepted Sprint 1 reference: **43aa8d7472aa8852654d0d634d7239c3765c5869**.
- Actual pre-change / last verified deployed main: **cc6b04c8e98191be591a3b755d25988148523909**; no fresh live deployment inspection is claimed.
- Proposal branch started from that released main. The current Sprint 2 base and main have identical application trees; the additional main release merge introduces no file changes in this comparison. GitHub and local comparison show exactly four new Lab 7 Markdown documents. Sprint 3 staging is still the older 48d10cf and would pull unrelated implementation into the review diff, so it is not used here.
- Completed D2 documentation at **427d7c01ea9a62a5172a9a85ce4c6a9d48326e23**, original approval/retest/RED/GREEN evidence and local pending PDF filename work are preserved.

## Proposed change and impact

Otherwise valid creation and owner-authorized RETURNED Save would accept numeric integers **1, 100000, 100001 and 150000**, rejecting **150001, zero, negative, fractional and non-number** values without domain mutations. Preserve title/category rules, session/role/ownership/Origin, server-derived assignment, body shape, read-only submitted/terminal records, current revision predicates, atomic history, manual Save/Resubmit and draft recovery/BF-01.

The shared server parser affects both creation and returned editing; both client amount controls currently cap at100000. The original PostgreSQL `ExpenseRequest_amountBaht_check` also enforces1–100000. Therefore the proposal includes a **future additive CHECK-constraint migration**, with no row rewrite or Prisma Int type change. No migration is implemented in this PR. Review fresh/populated upgrade preservation and rollback: after larger rows exist, silently reinstating the old constraint or deleting/narrowing data is not safe. The documented forward-correction/application-rollback limitations must remain explicit.

## Documents for review

- [Change request, verified baseline and impact matrix](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/blob/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb/docs/labs/lab-07/proposal.md)
- [OLD / PROPOSED NEW assessed contract, 8 proposed ACs and 10 planned STS cases](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/blob/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb/docs/labs/lab-07/contract-proposed-v1.md)
- [Parts A-D checklist, five metric definitions and readiness/retrospective plan](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/blob/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb/docs/labs/lab-07/evidence-plan.md)
- [Preparation checks, preserved local work and instructor/TA handoff draft](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/blob/12d40ecf571d50a012045b324d48ae50459c21eb/docs/labs/lab-07/preparation-validation-2026-11-27.md)

## Substantive reviewer checklist

- [ ] Is this a precise change to the already accepted Sprint 1 BR-01, with correct old/new boundaries and explicit F-02/F-05 scope rather than a bug fix or unchanged backlog completion?
- [ ] Do the SRS/Feature SDS/System SDS impact mappings and AC-L7-01–08 / STS-L7-01–10 specify independent expected outcomes, meaningful future semantic RED and legitimate changes only to old100001-invalid expectations?
- [ ] Are authorization, Origin, owner/status/revision guard precedence, replay/stale outcomes, atomic events and draft lifecycle preserved, including negative/no-mutation cases?
- [ ] Are server validation, both UI constraints/messages and the actual PostgreSQL CHECK consistent, with independent backend/constraint tests instead of browser-only enforcement?
- [ ] Are populated-data preservation, migration order, old-instance rollout behavior and rollback limits correct without rewriting old rows/history or narrowing over larger values?
- [ ] Are approval/review provenance, future execution/metrics windows, historical limitations and the review→RED→GREEN→regression→CI→staging→reviewed main→deployment plan truthful and sufficient?

Please record findings, their disposition and the exact reviewed SHA through the normal independent review process. A favourable review is contract feedback, not instructor/TA authorization, implementation acceptance, deployment approval or whole-product completion.

## Preparation validation

Documentation checks passed: four strict-UTF-8 Markdown files,14local links,11tables/95rows,8proposed ACs,10planned STS IDs,5pinned source objects and zero secret-pattern findings. Local and remote diff scope and whitespace checked. No production/test/migration/dependency changes; no application suites, live writes or deployment. No reviewer assignment, automatic message, merge or Issue closure is part of this step.
